subject: AWS listing: pricing buckets, co-sell SLAs & hero copy options
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@pioneerdatalabs.com>
Cc: procurement@pioneerdatalabs.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing: pricing buckets, co-sell SLAs & hero copy options

Team / Samantha — looping both sides to close the remaining items for the AWS Offer page. We have a draft pricing buckets sheet and an SLA/co-sell language doc attached. Goal is to finalize the product page copy and procurement footnotes so the Marketplace listing can go live next week.

Key asks (short):
- Kimberly: can you review the hero copy options and pick the preferred headline + one-line benefit? Attached hero_copy_options.md has 3 variants.
- Rachel: product/field — are the pricing buckets realistic for a pilot (monthly commit tiers + burst)? See pricing_buckets_v3.xlsx. We need a clear “trial” footnote for AWS Trial/SKU.
- Samantha / Procurement: any blockers on the contract language in sla_co_sell_draft.docx (particularly co-sell commitment and support response times)?

Notes and constraints:
- For Marketplace visibility, AWS requires an explicit trial SKU description and any metering caveats called out in the product page copy.
- Co-sell language should not promise custom SLAs beyond the reserved Dedicated offering; instead propose a co-sell handshake and an escalation SLA for pilot customers.

Attachments: pricing_buckets_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), sla_co_sell_draft.docx (word), hero_copy_options.md (text)

Thanks — I’ll run a short sync tomorrow if we can’t converge asynchronously.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Partner GTM Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@pioneerdatalabs.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 17:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing: pricing buckets, co-sell SLAs & hero copy options

Thanks Logan — quick pass below. I also attached a redlined hero copy doc and a short alt for the trial footnote. High-level:

Hero copy picks:
- Lead headline: "Predictable, production LLM inference at cloud scale" (variant 2 with minor tweak).
- Subhead: "Turn models into reliable, cost-effective features — hosted, dedicated, or private."

Product bullets (short):
- High-throughput GPU runtime with KV caching and intelligent batching
- SLA-backed Dedicated pools and transparent per-token economics
- Private deployment options and enterprise controls

Pricing buckets feedback (from my read of pricing_buckets_v3.xlsx):
- Keep three public tiers: Starter (pay-as-you-go), Standard (modest monthly commit), Enterprise (custom/Reserved).
- Remove any language that implies unlimited burst beyond reserved capacity — that will trigger procurement/legal questions. Replace with: "Burst capacity subject to availability; see dedication terms."

Trial footnote suggestion (short):
- "30-day trial applies to Starter and Standard SKUs. Trial does not include Dedicated reserved capacity. Usage during trial billed at pay-as-you-go rates."

SLA language (quick):
- Do not include hard 99.99% for hosted API on the product page. Instead: "SLA options available with Reserved Dedicated plans; pilot co-sell customers receive a prioritized escalation path and committed response times."

Inline edits: see attached hero_copy_options.md (with tracked choices) and a new short form we can use for the listing's short description.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute sync if needed — otherwise I can make the suggested edits and push a staging page copy.

— Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Marketplace & Partner GTM

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@pioneerdatalabs.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: pricing buckets, co-sell SLAs & hero copy options

Appreciate the drafts — from a field perspective a couple clarifications before we finalize: 

- Pricing: Pioneer is interested in a short-term pilot at ~$8k/mo committed (Standard tier). The buckets in pricing_buckets_v3.xlsx look fine, but procurement will request a clear callout on overage math. Can we add a short table in the product page that says: "Overage: $X per 1k tokens beyond committed usage"?
- Trial: field ask is to allow a time-limited Dedicated trial for strategic customers (with signed MSA + deposit). We should not call that out on the public product page; add that as a field-only note tied to the sales playbook.
- Co-sell: Pioneer wants joint PR/announcement support if we secure a pilot. Kimberly — can we add a short co-sell blurb under the partner section that says: "Joint GTM available for qualified pilots"?

I made two small edits in hero_copy_options.md (attached). If everyone is good I can sign off and we request a staging listing slot with AWS for next Tuesday.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Field Reps, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@pioneerdatalabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pioneerdatalabs.com
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: pricing buckets, co-sell SLAs & hero copy options

Logan / Kimberly / Rachel — thanks for the clear options. A few procurement items on our side: 

- SLA language: Procurement confirmed they are comfortable with prioritized escalation for pilots, but we need a clear response-time table (e.g., P1: 1 hour, P2: 4 hours, P3: 24 hours) to attach to our PO. Is that something you can provide in the SLA draft?
- Pricing buckets: we prefer the Standard committed tier with an option to convert to Reserved after 90 days. Is that an available transition path?
- DocuSign: we've prepared a PO and a short MSA addendum for pilot terms. Linking the DocuSign here: https://docusign.com/XYZ-Pioneer-Po (placeholder).

We appreciate the co-sell support note — marketing will want an approximate timeline if we go public. Happy to keep that private until pilot metrics are validated.

— Samantha Lee
VP, Product & Data, Pioneer Data Labs

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@pioneerdatalabs.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: pricing buckets, co-sell SLAs & hero copy options

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 

1) Kimberly: please push the hero copy variant 2 to the staging page and include the short product bullets Rachel confirmed. Also add the co-sell blurb under partner section: "Joint GTM available for qualified pilots."
2) Rachel: I'll add the overage table to the listing copy (placeholder numbers until finance confirms), and hold the Dedicated trial language to internal sales playbook only.
3) Samantha / Procurement: Logan will send a quick SLA response-time table for pilot use and confirm conversion path to Reserved after 90 days. I’ll also review the DocuSign link and confirm receipt with legal.

I'll schedule a 15-minute check-in Monday morning to confirm the staging slot with AWS and sign-off on copy.

Attachments being published to staging: pricing_buckets_v3.xlsx, sla_co_sell_draft.docx, hero_copy_options.md

— Logan
Logan Wright
Partner GTM Manager, Redwood Inference
